_WARNING: This file is for script author reference and debug only. It is not used in script execution.

dut.label: DUT parameters. **NOTE** EDIT to match device under test.

debug.label: Set true to enable extra debug info for some tests

oBox_server.label: octoBox Server params. **NOTE** EDIT publicip to equal the IP address of your octobox system.

stackTypeOverride.label: This value overrides the systemConfig stackType value when looking up box-to-box path info in pathinfo.json. Leave it blank to use the value in systemConfig. **IMPORTANT** The value must be a valid dictionary in pathinfo.json. This should be used only if a system has a non-standard attenuator configuration.

autotest_timeout_factor.label: Calculated step duration is multipled by this to set test timeout check.

rest_timeout.label: Maximum wait for REST API call to respond. Integer seconds.

retryRequests.label: Set true to retry makeArequest requests.

skipIgenCheck.label: Set true to skip checking & resetting iGen.

WAITPARAMETERS.label: THESE ARE USED BY MANY SCRIPTS, SO BE CAREFUL WHEN CHANGING.

meshSetupTime.label: Wait time after initializing mesh backhaul attenuators for mesh to establish

defaultSettlingTime.label: Time to wait before making measurement(sec) [integer]

delay_after_capture_stop.label: Time (seconds) to wait after stopping sniffer capture.

ping_wait_time_seconds.label: Wait seconds for ping to succeed

delay_before_test_status_check.label: Wait seconds before checking test  status

avgData_delay_seconds.label: Wait seconds before calling avgData API

SCRIPT_AUTOCONFIGURE_PARAMETERS.label: THESE PARAMETERS CONTROL HOW SCRIPTS SELF CONFIGURE FOR DIFFERENT STACKS.

funcsCanTerminate.label: Set true to allow sd2Utils functions to terminate script on error.

useHelper.label: Set true to have script(s) use Helper file.

useDutMap.label: Set true to have script(s) use dutMap.json.

usePathInfo.label: Set true to have script(s) use pathinfo.json.

FILE-LOCATION_N_PATH_PARAMETERS.label: CHANGE ONLY IF YOU KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING AND FILES ARE MOVED FROM THESE LOCATIONS.

basicServer_location.label: Full path to basic-server directory on octobox server.

HOUSE_PROFILE_CONVERSION_PARAMETERS.label: CHANGE ONLY IF YOU KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING.

houseProfile_channel.label: Channel for houseProfile rssi to attenuator conversion. (Default 44)

houseProfile_xmitPower.label: DUT transmit powerfor houseProfile rssi to attenuator conversion. (Default 20)

PAL-STAPAL_PARAMETERS.label: THESE VALUES ARE USED AS DEFAULT VALUES. CHANGE ONLY IF YOU KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING.

testDescription.val: Minimal params_test.json required for the simplest automated test.
testDescription.label: Test Description

trainingInterval.label: Time to wait before making measurement(sec) [integer]

step.label: Quad attenuator step size (dB). Set = 1 for static attenution.

stepDuration.label: How long to spend at each attenuation step (seconds).

trafficType.label: Traffic type to run [iperf2 | iperf3 | ping | None]

trafficBW.label: Bit rate.  Use #K or #M, like 20M for 20 Mbps

totalTests.label: Total number of tests to run.  It will run at least once, regardless of this value.

usePalAsAP.label: Use this Pal as the AP. If blank, this is not done.

palAPsecurity.label: Security mode for Pal as AP

palAPpassword.label: Security password for Pal as AP

palAPchannel.label: Channel of operation for Pal as AP
